name: ECA Integrated Solution Berhad
overview: 2026年，ECA Integrated Solution Berhad 的主要业务动态为出售子公司 ECA Innotech Sdn Bhd 70% 股权，并推进 20% 私募配售及员工认股计划（ESOS）等企业融资活动；公告中未披露各业务板块的产能、订单或市场扩张事项。
overview_en: In 2026, ECA Integrated Solution Berhad's main business development was the disposal of a 70% equity interest in subsidiary ECA Innotech Sdn Bhd, alongside corporate fundraising activities including a 20% private placement and an employees' share option scheme (ESOS); no capacity, order, or market expansion matters for individual business segments were disclosed in the announcements.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面推进私募配售与 ESOS，并出售子公司 ECA Innotech 70% 股权。
segments.note_en: At the group level this year, the company progressed a private placement and ESOS, and disposed of a 70% equity interest in subsidiary ECA Innotech.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: ESOS 于 2026 年 10 月 12 日生效。
actions.text_en: The ESOS became effective on 12 October 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 于 2026 年 7 月 22 日批准最多 146,497,227 股私募配售新股及 ESOS 项下最多占已发行股份 15% 的新股上市。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities approved on 22 July 2026 the listing of up to 146,497,227 placement shares and up to 15% of issued shares under the ESOS.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Wong Kah Yeong 及 Hu Jun 签订有条件买卖协议，以 RM70,000 现金出售 ECA Innotech Sdn Bhd 70% 股权（70,000 股）。
actions.text_en: Entered into a conditional share purchase agreement with Wong Kah Yeong and Hu Jun to dispose of 70,000 shares representing 70.00% equity interest in ECA Innotech Sdn Bhd for a cash consideration of RM70,000.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 于 2026 年 5 月 14 日批准最多 57,904,042 股私募配售新股上市。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities approved on 14 May 2026 the listing of up to 57,904,042 new placement shares.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 并设立最多占已发行股份 15% 的 ESOS。
actions.text_en: Proposed a private placement of up to 10% of issued shares and an establishment of an ESOS of up to 15% of issued shares.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 出售 ECA Innotech Sdn Bhd 70% 股权，该公司不再为全资子公司。
model_changes.text_en: Disposal of 70% equity interest in ECA Innotech Sdn Bhd, which ceased to be a wholly-owned subsidiary.
